terminal.cant.get.output.tips:
Unable to get terminal output, you can try the following troubleshooting methods:
1. Run Again: Try killing the terminal, stop the current session and rerun the command. This will refresh the terminal connection and is likely to solve the problem.
2. Check the default terminal configuration: Check if the default terminal profile (Shortcut: CMD/CTRL + Shift + P → Terminal: Select Default Profile) is one of the supported shell types - Git Bash, pwsh, bash, fish, pwsh, zsh. If not, you need to set it to one of these shell types;
